[[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] used a '''''Providence''-class carrier/destroyer''' as his [[Command ship/Legends|command ship]] at the [[Battle of Kamino/Legends|Battle of Kamino]], in which he abandoned it while leading his [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]]' landing in [[Tipoca City/Legends|Tipoca City]].
